_doc: Mirror of FEINT_LEFT (uses ATTACK_LOW_RL's windup), then pulls back to rest (captured.end).

_help.like: uses this slash's windup (sword cocked low on the RIGHT), then pulls back
_help.pull_back.lift: shoulder offset from the windup for the pull back (deg; negative = up/back)
_help.pull_back.wrist: wrist offset for the pull back (deg)
_help.captured.end: end pose captured from the arm (real degrees): the rest pose, so the feint pulls all the way back at the end. Overrides pull_back. Delete the entry to go back to the computed pose.
